sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.4533/2026, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant Anil alias Kailash Bheel.

This appeal is filed being aggrieved of the judgment dated 27.06.2019 passed by the learned First Additional Session Judge and Special Judge (POCSO) Piparity, District Hoshangabad in S.T.
No.304/2015 whereby appellant Anil alias Kailash Bheel has been convicted as under :-
 Conviction Senten  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fin  
 376(2)(jha) 
IPC R.I. for Life Rs.1000/-
 (dha) 
It is submitted that mother of the victim is PW-2.

entities.text: First Additional Session Judge and Special Judge (POCSO) Piparity, District Hoshangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Name of the mother and father of the victim are evident from the deposition sheet (Ex.P-2) whereas in the school records Ex.P-23/C, names of the father and mother are mentioned as 'B' and 'K', which causes doubt as to the identity of the victim.
This fact has been admitted by PW-2 (P) that she is the mother of the victim but her name is not mentioned in the school records.
Same is the status in regard to father.
She admits that her first husband was 'M' with whom her marriage was performed when she was 16 years of age. PW-2 2 CRA-7098-2019 reflected her age to be 40 years.

Then, she stated that after her marriage with 'M',
her first husband died after birth of the victim.
Victim was born after one year of the marriage thereafter she had performed second marriage with 'D'.

sentences.text: Thus, neither the name of 'M' is mentioned as father of the victim nor that of 'D' is mentioned as father of the victim but name of 'B' is mentioned which is incorrect.
Therefore, identity of the parents of the victim being doubtful.
School records (Ex.P-23/C) cannot be accepted to be a proof of age of the victim.
Once this is discarded, then the second piece of evidence available on record is Ex.P-16.
Ossification test report conducted by, PW-14, Dr. R.S. Shukla, Radiologist, District Hospital Hoshangabad, who certified that age of the victim was about 16 years.
PW-14 , Dr. R.S. Shukla, categorically reported that age of the victim was about 16 years.
This mater pertains to year 2015.
That time provisions of POCSO Act were not amended.
Amendment took place with effect from 16.08.2019.

Prior to amendment of Section 6 of the POCSO Act, minimum sentence for aggravated penetrative sexual assault was prescribed to be not less than 10 years and when this aspect is taken into consideration,
since appellant has already spent more than 10 years incarceration, we deem it proper to grant suspension of sentence, I.A. No.4533/2026 is allowed.
Accordingly, I.A. No.4533/2026 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with 3 CRA-7098-2019 two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 21.05.2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant Anil alias Kailash Bheel shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
